name: Hate to Say I Told You So

info.album: Hate to Say I Told You So (Live) [Radio Edit]

podcast.body: A song from their album "Vini Vidi Vicious," which found its audience after the album's re-release in April 2002. "The Hives, with hate to say I told you so from their album, Vini Vidi Vicious."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track is presented as an "amazing slice of modern Garage Rock" from The Hives. It contributed to their rapid ascent to a major label deal after their second studio album, "Vini Vidi Vicious," released in 2000. "Swedish Garage Rock, The Hives, and I hate to say I told you so."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Alt Rock Revivals Part 4: Garage Rock
